explication: Flutter Agent Plugins is a collection of agent-facing skills, rules, and plugin metadata for Flutter development. The main workflow is an agent selecting a task-specific skill, following its guidance, and applying changes in a Flutter project. The README documents testing, UI/layout, architecture, serialization, routing, localization, and HTTP workflows; the tree also contains Dart skills and hot-reload rules. Source excerpts were unavailable, so edges reflect documented packaging and use rather than inferred implementation calls.
